conbody.p: If there is an RTW on the claim that falls on or after the renewal or conversion date, it prevents the payment of benefits even if the officer inputs a renewal or conversion week. The Level 1 officer refers to the National Policy on Levels of Decision and Correcting a found work or return to work input in error to determine if the conditions are met to rescind or modify the RTW. The Level 1 officer rescinds the RTW when converting the claim. If the decision on the RTW is not within Level 1 authority, the Level 1 officer refers the issue to Level 2.
